title: DryFarmlandForever
description: Keeps farmland dry forever + prevents trampling
body:
# DryFarmlandForever
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- This plugin keeps farmland dry forever + prevents trampling on the farmland.
- The purpose of this plugin is to slowdown the experience of growing crops.
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
